question: Three long parallel wires A, B, and C are arranged in a straight line such that B is midway between A and C. The distance between adjacent wires is $d$. Wire A carries current $I$ (up) and wire C carries current $3I$ (up). What current in wire B is required so that the net magnetic force on wire B is zero?

options.D: It is impossible to make the net force on B zero
